subject: Integration sprint: network & org milestones (API keys, allowlist, VPC)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@corehealth.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration sprint: network & org milestones (API keys, allowlist, VPC)

Sara — thanks for the kickoff today. Per our conversation I drafted a short two-week integration sprint that captures the four critical items we need to close before we start sustained load testing. Please see the action list below and confirm feasibility against your internal schedules.

High-level goal: Have Redwood serving behind your test VPC and allowlisted IPs with org-level API keys by 2026-10-30 so we can begin eval traffic the week of 2026-11-02.

Action items (owner / target):
- Customer org setup: CoreHealth creates Redwood organization and assigns an admin (owner: CoreHealth / target: 2026-10-24)
- API keys: Redwood to provide onboarding docs and one-time provisioning key; CoreHealth admin to generate production key and add to secrets manager (owner: Redwood / CoreHealth — target: 2026-10-25)
- IP allowlist: CoreHealth to provide public egress ranges; Redwood to provide recommended CIDR whitelist and temporary testing entry (owner: CoreHealth / target: 2026-10-26)
- VPC peering: CoreHealth to provide AWS account ID and VPC CIDR; Redwood will initiate peering and exchange route table entries (owner: CoreHealth / Redwood / target: 2026-10-28)

Attachments: I’ve attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan (CoreHealth-MAP-v1.pdf) and a short VPC peering instructions PDF. Marcus — can you confirm steps for API key creation and the minimal testing configuration? Monica — I scheduled a 30-minute check-in for Monday to confirm final dates (invite attached in calendar).

Next step: Sara, please reply with the AWS account ID and your public egress CIDRs so Marcus can open the peering ticket. If any of the dates above look tight, flag which items you want to slide.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0172
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@corehealth.co>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Network Team <netops@corehealth.co>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration sprint: network & org milestones (API keys, allowlist, VPC)

Thanks Jonas — the timeline looks reasonable. A few details from our side:

- AWS account ID (peering): 123456789012
- Primary VPC CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16 (we will create a dedicated subnet 10.20.100.0/24 for the test cluster)
- Public egress (for allowlist): 34.210.45.0/24, 34.210.46.0/24
- Our security team prefers the peering be established in the test account and only routes for 10.20.100.0/24 shared.

We also need an onboarding checklist for the org admin to avoid missteps on key rotation. Target: please have peering initiated and a temporary API key configured by 2026-10-28. If possible, can you also provide an expected list of source IPs Redwood will use for control-plane calls? Network team will need both the control-plane allowlist and the data-plane endpoints.

Sara
Sara Kim
Head of Integrations | CoreHealth
sara.kim@corehealth.co
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@corehealth.co>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration sprint: network & org milestones (API keys, allowlist, VPC)

Hi Sara — thanks for the details, that helps a lot. Quick confirmations + next steps from the Redwood side: 

1) Control-plane / source IPs: For the short test window we will originate management/control-plane calls from the following egress ranges (these are our public NAT IPs): 52.34.112.45, 52.34.112.46. For production we can provide a CIDR block; for now please allow those two IPs to unblock test traffic.

2) API key process:
- I will upload a one-time onboarding key to the shared Drive for your admin to use to register the org (file: onboarding-temp-key.txt).
- Steps for CoreHealth admin: sign into console.redwood.ai -> Organization settings -> Create API Key -> Paste onboarding key in "Link existing org" flow -> Rotate key and store in Vault/Secrets Manager.
- We recommend rotating the temporary key within 48 hours after registration.

3) VPC peering specifics:
- Redwood account ID (for your peering request): 210987654321
- Redwood VPC CIDR for peer: 172.31.200.0/24
- We will only add a route for 10.20.100.0/24 to keep the blast radius limited. Please confirm your route table IDs once peering is accepted.

4) Tickets / attachments: I’ve attached redwood-vpc-peering-instructions.pdf and a sample vpc-peer-template.csv you can drop into your internal ticketing system. I’ll open an internal peering request once Sara confirms the route table ID and the test subnet will be ready.

If CoreHealth wants, we can also provide a temporary JWT-based test key instead of using an onboarding file. Let me know preference.

Cheers,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments (referenced): redwood-vpc-peering-instructions.pdf, vpc-peer-template.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@corehealth.co>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration sprint: network & org milestones (API keys, allowlist, VPC)

Folks — calendar invite sent for Monday 2026-10-26 10:00 PT (30m) to confirm final dates and handoff ownership. Agenda in the Invite: 1) Confirm CoreHealth org admin + access 2) Review API key steps and rotation 3) Verify peering request fields and route table IDs 4) Define acceptance criteria for eval (50 req/sec steady-state + sample prompt set).

I also uploaded the Mutual Action Plan to the shared Drive (link below). Please add comments directly to the doc before the meeting so we can finalize the dates.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleSharedDoc
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4821 (I added jira: NETOPS-88 to track the peering work)

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration sprint: network & org milestones (API keys, allowlist, VPC)

Quick internal note after Monday's sync:
- CoreHealth confirmed account and will complete org registration by 2026-10-24.
- Marcus to post onboarding-temp-key.txt to Drive and open internal peering request (internal ticket: NETOPS-88).
- Monica to finalize HubSpot timeline and update DEAL-4821 close plan.
- Sara's team will provide route table IDs and accept peering by 2026-10-28; target for test traffic remain 2026-11-02.

I'll follow up on Friday if any of the owners report blockers.

Jonas
